items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: So from then on I just went to the old Sliphorn and got Professor Clevon Williams to come down to teach me.

ctx.x: Oh, I imagine I was about 16, something like that, around that neighborhood. And they had a fellow out there, I forget his name, but we used to call him Cousin Lawrence. He left with a fellow by the name of Paul Jones. They left there and they went to Shrekeport. And he had a wonderful brass band out there, I forget the name of it. And I always admired that man's trombone player, and he was a wonderful trombone player. So I said, one of these days I'm going to try to be a trombone player like my cousin. So from…
Any relation? No, no relation at all.
